title: console.assert(true) prints nothing
notes: console is a global per rfd#44 (superseding RFD 32's console-is-gone world). console.assert only writes when the condition is falsy (WHATWG Console Standard); with a truthy condition it is a no-op. Exit 0, stdout and stderr both empty. Pairs with console_assert_false_stderr, which exercises the falsy branch.
